about_the_game:
"Cali and The Secrets of The New Home" is an 8-scene jigsaw puzzle game where players discover the story of Cali, a black kitten on her adoption adventure.

 

Follow her discovery-filled story through beautiful images from Cali's perspective, showing the exploratory, imaginative and curious nature of cats.

 

Game Features:

  • 🧩 3 difficulty levels: Easy (144 pieces), Medium (350 pieces), Hard (777 pieces).

  • 🎵 Original soundtrack: Relaxing and immersive.

  • 🔍 Helpful tools: Zoom, highlight pieces (edges/specific quadrants), shuffle pieces and    image preview.

  • 📖 Engaging story: Each completed scene reveals a chapter of Cali's journey!

 

This is a game for cat lovers! But we also aim to raise awareness about the importance of adopting black cats, who are often overlooked in shelters due to spiritual prejudices or being seen as too "common". Black cats are just as beautiful and full of love to give as any other cat!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 2 Ghz Dual Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card supporting DirectX 9.0c
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any

short_description: Cali is a beautiful and affectionate kitten looking for a family, but adoption is much harder for black cats. Follow her story full of adventures and discoveries in this jigsaw puzzle game composed of 8 scenes.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Dutch, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Croatian, Danish, Finnish, Norwegian, Polish, Swedish, Czech, Turkish, Ukrainian
